# format: 2
#
# Generated by `cargo xtask agent-snapshot --update`; do not edit.
# The agent protocol surface: one block per method — name, permission class, MCP tool
# name, mutating flag, cost class, dispatcher limits, params schema (kinds and the
# structured JSON Schema shapes), result schema and documented error codes — plus the
# built-in extension methods and the universal error codes. `cargo xtask agent-snapshot
# --check` fails when the tables differ: a breaking change needs the method named under
# `## Upgrade` and every change a `## New` line in a docs/releases/*.md fragment this
# branch touches, and `--update` itself refuses to write an undocumented change (the
# refreshed snapshot must be committed too; book/agents/protocol.md, "Stability").
